data.content_ref: inline:The target names 'abstraction' as its covering principle but the stated 'REFUTED IF' only tests whether linear pricing is conventionally fixed. That refutation condition is specific to the pencil instance, not to the abstraction: eliminating alternative interpretations for the pencil case leaves the broader 'class of pricing-model underdetermination' untouched (other unit-rate problems could still be underdetermined). The refutation condition therefore does not actually falsify the proposed abstraction — it falsifies at most the instance membership claim — so the target fails to establish a substantive relation whose negation is testable.
